status: pre-registered after a smoke on Pythia-160m block 3 (48 windows, 30 neurons, 3 checkpoints), before the full runs; OLMo's smoke follows but changes no hypothesis
question: Does e672 replicate on other blocks and models: inside a single route the larger part of a neuron's top firings becomes top firings before the rest (found after the fact in e672), while a neuron's distinct routes form in no order and its offshoot firings cost as much as its core firings? And Gemini 4's SwiGLU question: are apparent offshoots the gate-closed double-negative leak firings?
design: Eight runs, each e672's measurement: Pythia-160m blocks 3 and 9; Pythia-410m blocks 6, 12, 18; OLMo-1B-0724 blocks 4, 8, 12. 256 windows x 256 tokens of wikitext-2 train; 300 sampled neurons with a substantial top 100 (Pythia: maximum above 1, as e672; OLMo: maximum above the 10th percentile of maxima); the exact upstream split through the block's LayerNorm (SwiGLU: gate and value split exactly and combined to the first-order attribution of the activation); k-means (k = 2) on the 256 largest units, two-route when the silhouette beats the 95th percentile of 20 unimodal nulls with the same mean and covariance and the minor group holds 10 or more; causal: the neuron zeroed in each window holding its firings, mean KL at core and offshoot firings, for every two-route neuron and 60 sampled one-route neurons (OLMo's ablations in TF32, checked against fp32 in its smoke); developmental: each firing's percentile at 11 checkpoints (Pythia 128 to 143000; OLMo 1000 to 512000 and the final 1454000), early score = mean percentile before the end, lead = larger group minus the rest after regressing out final activation and the firing's token typicality; OLMo also on the top 100 gate-open firings (gate > 0).

hypotheses.H1: replication of e672's after-the-fact gradient: in each run, among one-route neurons, the larger group's lead (activation and token typicality regressed out) is positive in more than half, one-sided binomial p < 0.05 (verdict over the eight runs: supported if all, narrowed if some, refuted if none)
hypotheses.H2: the contrast e672 implied but did not test: pooled over the eight runs, the share of one-route neurons whose larger group leads exceeds the share of two-route neurons whose core leads, one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05
hypotheses.H3: the essay's developmental prediction again: pooled over the eight runs, among two-route neurons the core leads in more than half, one-sided binomial p < 0.05
hypotheses.H4: the essay's causal prediction again: pooled over the eight runs, among two-route neurons the offshoot's mean KL is below the core's in more than half, one-sided binomial p < 0.05
hypotheses.H5a: Gemini's leak hypothesis: in OLMo (the three runs pooled), among two-route neurons whose top 100 include gate-closed firings and whose two routes differ in their gate-closed share, the offshoot has the larger share in more than half, one-sided binomial p < 0.05
hypotheses.H5b: Gemini's collapse: in OLMo (pooled), at least half of the two-route neurons become one-route when only gate-open firings are kept
hypotheses.H6: the essay's causal prediction on clean firings: in OLMo (pooled), among two-route neurons of the gate-open top 100, the offshoot's mean KL is below the core's in more than half, one-sided binomial p < 0.05
